I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread to confirm I'd noted the 7 October deadline for Quarrendon Freight Lines' signed order form. The deadline is a date, not a money figure, so it was fine to repeat in the channel.

I also mentioned that 7 October was already past on the simulation clock (16 October), and asked Ilse to say if they meant a different date or if the form is still outstanding. They said no action was needed, so I did nothing else.
